material.acceptance_criteria: createMinimap no longer takes units (ui_minimap.js:38-39 and hud.js:65 drop it), and dotSize is removed or gains a caller; codesearch for units in ui_minimap.js matches only comment lines.
material.commit_comment: Witness: 1792901130056-5742-41a745850d5ef30d (dotSize 0 matches); units argument removed from the hud.js createMinimap call
material.description: Fact: createMinimap destructures units (js/client/ui_minimap.js:38) and stores it in the hot registry (js/client/ui_minimap.js:39), but nothing reads it: codesearch finds units only at ui_minimap.js lines 1, 3, 38, 39. paint and draw take their unit list from draw(list) (js/client/ui_minimap.js:158). js/client/hud.js:65 still passes units. dotSize is exported at js/client/ui_minimap.js:26 and has no caller in the repository (one match across 1158 files). Symptom: a maintainer reading the call site sees a second unit source that the minimap ignores, and an exported helper nothing uses.

notes.note: Triage keep (maintainer-visible). Located: ui_minimap.js:38-39 destructures units and stores it in hot; the file reads it nowhere. hud.js:65 still passes units. dotSize at ui_minimap.js:26 has one occurrence repo-wide, its own definition (codesearch dispatch 1792859746668-6568-62dc7d6bac99193). Observable to a maintainer: a dead option and an exported helper with no caller. Reads: ui_minimap.js 1-205 dispatch 1792859429070-6387-47df82884af9e433; hud.js 55-80 dispatch 1792859542628-6438-81e549ecc64522c3.
